articleTitle: Efficacy of Sativex® on Pain, Spasticity, and Disability in Patients With Multiple Sclerosis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
takeaways: Sativex (nabiximols) demonstrated significant pain reduction in MS patients, with a standardized mean change of -0.88 on the Numeric Rating Scale, indicating substantial improvement in pain intensity
MS patients using Sativex experienced significant spasticity reduction with a standardized mean change of -1.29, representing meaningful improvement in muscle stiffness and involuntary contractions
Sativex provided modest but statistically significant improvement in overall disability scores on the Expanded Disability Status Scale (EDSS) with a standardized mean change of -0.17
This meta-analysis included 20 high-quality studies from 1,203 initially reviewed articles, providing robust evidence for Sativex effectiveness across multiple MS symptoms
Spasticity affects 60-84% of MS patients and contributes significantly to both pain and motor dysfunction, making Sativex's dual action on both symptoms particularly valuable
